historical.calendar: Use the exact five saved V4 annual test windows (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, final 2026 Jan-Sep). Every historical cell is inspected-history exploratory; no fresh/untouched holdout claim.

candidates.rule: Zero target weight on every scheduled decision.

historical.cell_grid: 7 candidates x 2 symbols x 5 fixed folds x 3 cost scenarios

drawdown_halt.cadence: each scheduled observed 04:00 UTC open before target execution
drawdown_halt.gap: a missing or zero-volume open creates no fill; position carries to the next valid scheduled open and an observed gap may overshoot the halt
drawdown_halt.sticky: remain in cash through the fold

common_risk_manager.realized_vol: Population standard deviation of previous 20 daily close-to-close returns, annualized by sqrt(365).
rebalance_exceptions: always trim a post-marked weight above 0.50
common_risk_manager.trade_sizing: Solve for the exact requested post-trade marked asset weight after fee and slippage; never allow negative cash or leverage.

historical.decision_time: 00:00 UTC each day, using only completed daily closes through the prior UTC day; execute at scheduled 04:00 UTC open.
historical.final_liquidation: Fixed calendar endpoint from each saved V4 fold, at the prescribed last 04:00 UTC open; if that exact open is missing or has zero volume, mark that candidate-symbol-fold-cost cell incomplete. Never move endpoint to a surviving row.
historical.indicator_data: Price-only daily close rules. Require contiguous completed UTC daily closes for each indicator window; no filling. The 20-day volatility manager requires 21 contiguous prior closes. Invalid signal windows cause no new signal; position remains unchanged until a valid decision or fixed liquidation.
historical.interpretation: A lower drawdown caused by reduced exposure is risk management, not predictive alpha. Label all historical scores as exploratory on inspected history. No candidate is an investment recommendation.

required_comparisons: saved V4 signal with same common risk manager
historical.selection: No winner selection; preserve fixed candidate order: cash, passive, momentum_7d, frozen_v4_logistic, sma20_100, close_breakout_20_10, trend_gated_v4. Report all cells.
historical.source: Binance official spot monthly archive, BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT, 4h OHLCV, quote asset USDT
historical.uncertainty: No bootstrap in this run. Paired deterministic comparisons only; no inferential or prospective claim.

prospective_usd_paper.daily_decision: Only a newly received completed 00:00 UTC daily observation after cohort start may create that day’s decision. An observation received after the planned 04:00 UTC execution deadline is skipped with reason; no backdating.
prospective_usd_paper.entry_execution: Planned at 04:00 UTC; entry or rebalance expires 04:15 UTC. Require decision creation, request start and response receipt before planned due; require fresh provider/request/receipt timestamps for execution. Poll every 5 minutes only while active.
prospective_usd_paper.history: 365-day UTC daily price aggregate; retain exact timestamps, drop validated trailing partial observation; warmup-only indicator inputs, never P&L or backfilled decisions
prospective_usd_paper.polling: Single serialized worker; batch quotes at most every 5 minutes while active; daily history refresh at most once per UTC day. Standard TLS, bounded timeouts/response size; no credentials.

quote_validation.batch_atomicity: Both BTC and ETH quotes must validate in one request before processing any strategy or asset; otherwise no partial round.

prospective_usd_paper.restart_resume: Restart pauses, cancels pending scheduled actions, and creates a current-observation baseline; resume waits for a strictly new post-resume daily observation. Never catch up historical signals.
prospective_usd_paper.risk: Same 10% annual target, 20-day daily volatility, 10% volatility floor, 50% post-trade marked weight cap, 2.5 percentage-point band, 10% sticky drawdown halt; sampled-price marks and risk cadence are intraday and explicitly distinct from historical tests.
prospective_usd_paper.safety_exit: A halt/pause exit is decided at its own observed timestamp and may execute later only from a quote whose provider/request/receipt timestamps are all after that exit decision; label separately from scheduled entries.
prospective_usd_paper.source: CoinGecko public aggregate USD daily observations and batched BTC/ETH USD quotes; simulated proxy only, not venue execution
prospective_usd_paper.start: Explicit user action freezes cohort id/config hash/start UTC, initializes separate cash accounts and warmup baselines; start response is not a performance observation. Warmup is never replayed as positions or P&L.
prospective_usd_paper.state_reporting: Initial state is not started / zero forward days. Starting cash is not performance. No prospective evidence exists until post-start observations and fills accrue.
prospective_usd_paper.storage: Separate V5 forward SQLite namespace/file; never write V3 account tables, V4 research archive or mix Binance USDT weights/data with CoinGecko USD cohort.

purpose: Exploratory fixed-family comparison and a separate paused prospective USD paper cohort; not a profit guarantee or deployment path.
